args.title: Brightline Freight: Warehouse automation in 2026 (article + companion)
args.body:
- Pick rates rose 18% with autonomous carts in 2026 warehouse automation deployments.
- Integration took twice as long as planned.
- The biggest saving came from fewer mis-picks.

Source: Brightline Freight newsletter "Warehouse automation in 2026" (blog.brightline.example/2026/warehouse) and its companion piece (insights.brightline.example/warehouse/companion).
